transport_obligations.requirement: Every mandatory source instance maps to exactly one group whose membership is defined by exact equality of facility_type and operation_type.
The judgment remains true under every permutation of named instances within each mapped mandatory group; no premise depends on the arbitrary extracted instance label.
Each pose_idx resolves to the expected pose_id in the expected facility pool.
The four semantic occupancies resolve to four distinct pose-bool variables.
The pose-5702 source premise is a property of operation refinery_blue_iron at that pose, not of source_instance_id refinery_blue_iron_034.
Exactly one new linear constraint is added, with logical form sum(the four distinct presence literals) <= 3.
The A1 parent selects all four forbidden occupancies, so it is supplied only as known_feasible_hint=false and is never treated as a feasible post-cut witness.

known_architectural_risk.description: The historical certificate surface names mandatory instances, while pose_bool_exact_v1 consumes group-pose occupancies. Without an explicit transport proof, an apparently valid certificate may be lowered into a different object space.
known_architectural_risk.E001_policy: Fail before solve if any transport obligation is not mechanically discharged.
known_architectural_risk.future_direction: Prefer group-semantic literals in new judgments whenever the master representation has already quotiented named-instance symmetry.
